findings.title: CTF Flag - LFI Vulnerability Exploitation
findings.description: Successfully identified the CTF flag through LFI vulnerability analysis. The application at post.php had a Local File Inclusion vulnerability protected by preg_match('/\.\./', $file) which could be bypassed via double URL encoding (%252e%252f). The flag was found in the application source code.

findings.title: SQL Injection in PayBuddies Login (Port 35875)
findings.description: Boolean-based blind SQL injection in the username parameter of the PayBuddies login form. The application distinguishes between 'username not found' and 'password incorrect' responses, enabling blind SQLi extraction.
findings.evidence: Confirmed via boolean-based blind SQLi: admin' AND 1=1-- - returns {"response":"password"} (user found), admin' AND 1=2-- - returns {"response":"username"} (user not found). Extracted: MySQL 8.0.42, database payroll_db, table users with columns (user_id, username, password). User 'admin' has MD5 hash 7d39307ae824e70052c0aa16816a9b16.
